data.exact_reserve_text: During 2021 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $33.1m (2020: $16.5m). The syndicate's Marine, Property and Specialty Lines divisions all produced large releases on the 2019 underwriting year while Cyber & Executive Risk produced a net release of $4.4m despite an increase in ransomware claims activity on the 2020 underwriting year. The syndicate has taken action in the Property division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the entering into a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) of the divisions Engineering classes in March 2021, contributing to the release of $9.0m in the division.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior-year reserve release of $33.1m in 2021 (2020: $16.5m), driven by favourable claims development across several divisions and specific reserve remediation actions (notably a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer in the Property/Engineering classes contributing $9.0m). Releases were concentrated in Marine, Property and Specialty Lines, while Political, Accident & Contingency showed adverse movement. The movement reflects a mix of benign claims experience, portfolio diversification, and reserve methodology actions including reinsurance/LPT arrangements.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). The opening reserves value was taken from the balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (31 Dec 2020). The prior-year development figure ($33.1m) was taken from the managing agent's narrative which states 'released prior year reserves of $33.1m' - the narrative does not explicitly label this as gross or net, but the division breakdown that follows appears to be gross releases by division; therefore the figure is treated as gross. A detailed gross claims development triangle is present in the Technical Provisions note (percentage and amounts) and was used to cross-check direction; RITC activity (Part VII transfer) is noted in the accounts and may distort comparisons of very old years but does not appear to affect the explicit $33.1m release statement. Field names include '_gbp_m' due to schema naming convention but values are in the native currency (USD millions).
